Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: The Login message is the first message sent to the Spin Server by a user's process after the connection to the Spin Server is established. Failure to login before sending any other message type will result in the connection being dropped by the Spin Server. The format of the Login message for the Spin Server is identical to that of the GRP.

Field.Name: SessionSubId
Field.Description: SessionSubId supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Username supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: (space filled)

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password supplied by Cboe.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: The Login Response message is sent by the Spin Server to a user's process in response to a Login message. The status field is used to reflect an accepted login or the reason the session was not accepted. If login fails, the connection will be dropped after the Login Response message is sent.

Field.Name: Login Response Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject.

Message.Name: Spin Image Available Message
Message.Description: The Spin Image Available message is sent once per second and indicates through what sequence number a spin is available.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Spin is available which is current through this sequence number.

Message.Name: Spin Request Message
Message.Description: The Spin Request message is used by a user's process to request transmission of a spin of the unit's order book. See Options Specific Symbol Processing for more complete details regarding Sequence specification as well as buffering requirements.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from a Spin Image Available message received by the member.

Message.Name: Spin Response Message
Message.Description: The Spin Response message is sent in response to a user's Spin Request message indicating whether a spin will be sent.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from a Spin Image Available message received by the member.

Field.Name: Order Count
Field.Description: Number of Add Order messages which will be contained in this spin.

Field.Name: Spin Response Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject. All non-A status codes should be interpreted as a reject.

Message.Name: Spin Finished Message
Message.Description: The Spin Finished message is sent to indicate that all messages for the spin requested have been sent. A Spin Finished message is only sent if a Spin Request message was not rejected. Upon receipt of a Spin Finished message, any buffered multicast messages should be applied to the member's copy of the book to make it current.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from the Spin Request message.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Request Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Request message is used by a user's process to request transmission of this unit's Symbol Mappings and Complex Instrument Definitions. Refer to Options Specific Symbol Processing for more complete details regarding Sequence specification as well as buffering requirements.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Must be 0. Only the current Symbol Mappings and Complex Instrument Definitions are available.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Response Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Response message is sent in response to a user's Instrument Definition Request message indicating whether a spin will be sent.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Will always be 0.

Field.Name: Instrument Count
Field.Description: Number of Symbol Mapping and Complex Instrument Definition messages (if applicable) which will be contained in this spin.

Field.Name: Instrument Definition Response Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject. All non-A status codes should be interpreted as a reject.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Finished Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Finished message is sent to indicate that all Symbol Mapping and Complex Instrument Definition messages for this unit have been sent. An Instrument Definition Finished message is only sent if an Instrument Definition Request message was not rejected.

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is immediately generated and sent when there is a PITCH event for a given clock second. If there is no PITCH event for a given clock second, then no Time message is sent for that second. All subsequent time offset fields for the same unit will use the new Time value as the base until another Time message is received for the same unit. The Time field is the number of seconds relative to midnight Eastern Time.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day, derived by converting the current Eastern wall clock time (HH:MM:SS) to seconds.

Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header. This message will be sent at startup each day. It would also be distributed in certain recovery events such as a data center fail-over.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Transaction Begin Message
Message.Description: The Transaction Begin message indicates any subsequent messages, up to the accompanying Transaction End message, are all part of the same transaction block.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Transaction End Message
Message.Description: The Transaction End message indicates that a transaction indicated by a previous Transaction Begin message has completed.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Add Order Long Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book. It includes a day-specific Order Id assigned by Cboe to the order.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order, S = Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Field.Name: Add Flags
Field.Description: Add Flags. See Add Flags bit field.

Message.Name: Add Order Short Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book. The Short variant is used when the price can be represented by a Binary Short Price and the quantity by an unsigned 16-bit integer.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order, S = Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Field.Name: Add Flags
Field.Description: Add Flags. See Add Flags bit field.

Message.Name: Add Order Expanded Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book. The Expanded variant accommodates larger symbol sizes possible through the ISRA plan and includes additional attribution fields.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order, S = Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Field.Name: Add Flags
Field.Description: Add Flags. See Add Flags bit field.

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Optionally specified. If specified, the Executing Firm ID of firm attributed to this quote. Space filled otherwise.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: Customer Indicator. Space means N/A on C2 Options.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Optional user specified value attributed to this quote. Space filled otherwise.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part. The execution will always be at the displayed price of the resting order.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition. See Options Trade Condition Codes.

Message.Name: Order Executed at Price Size Message
Message.Description: Order Executed at Price/Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part at a different price than the limit price on the original Add Order message or the limit order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Remaining Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts remaining after the execution.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition. See Options Trade Condition Codes.

Message.Name: Reduce Size Long Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts canceled.

Message.Name: Reduce Size Short Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced. The Short variant is used when the canceled quantity can be represented by an unsigned 16-bit integer.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts canceled.

Message.Name: Modify Order Long Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify.

Field.Name: Modify Flags
Field.Description: Modify Flags. See Modify Flags bit field.

Message.Name: Modify Order Short Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message. The Short variant is used when the price can be represented by a Binary Short Price and the quantity by an unsigned 16-bit integer.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify.

Field.Name: Modify Flags
Field.Description: Modify Flags. See Modify Flags bit field.

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: The Delete Order message is sent whenever a booked order is cancelled or leaves the order book.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been removed from the order book.

Message.Name: Trade Long Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always Buy Order regardless of resting side.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition. See Options Trade Condition Codes.

Message.Name: Trade Short Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers. The Short variant is used when the price can be represented by a Binary Short Price and the quantity by an unsigned 16-bit integer.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always Buy Order regardless of resting side.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition. See Options Trade Condition Codes.

Message.Name: Trade Expanded Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers. The Expanded variant accommodates larger symbol sizes possible through the ISRA plan.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always Buy Order regardless of resting side.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition. See Options Trade Condition Codes.

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on Cboe is broken. Trade breaks are rare, but can occur in the event of an erroneous execution.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe execution identifier of the execution that was broken.

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down for the trading day. This message is used as the signal that processing for the day is complete.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: A Symbol Mapping message is used to map the 6 character multicast feed symbol field to an OSI symbol and Underlying. These messages are not sequenced and are sent continuously through the day at variable rates as bandwidth allows.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol.

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: N = Normal, C = Closing Only.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of an options contract. A Trading Status message will be sent whenever a security's trading status changes. The Trading Status field will be used to represent the status of the RTH (9:30 a.m. ET - 4:15 p.m. ET) and Curb sessions. The GTH Trading Status field will be used to represent the status of series that trade during the GTH session. The GTH session runs from 8:15 p.m. to 9:25 a.m. ET for GTH-eligible Products (C1 only).

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: H = Halted, L = Curb Trading (C1 Only), Q = Quote-Only, R = Opening Rotation, T = RTH Trading.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: GTH Trading Status
Field.Description: C1 Only. H = Halted, Q = Quote-Only, R = Opening Rotation, T = Trading.

Field.Name: Reserved2
Field.Description: Reserved.

Message.Name: Width Update Message
Message.Description: The Width Update message is used to communicate opening quote width multiplier. This message will be sent in the event that the exchange decides to change the quote width multiplier on a per underlying basis.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Width Type
Field.Description: R = Regular, V = Volatility.

Field.Name: Multiplier
Field.Description: Width multiplier.

Message.Name: Options Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Options Auction Update messages are used to disseminate price and size information and Composite Market bid and offer prices during Opening and Re-Opening (halt) auctions on the Cboe Options Exchange.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: G = GTH Opening (C1 Only), O = RTH Opening (C1 Only), H = Halt Re-Opening, V = Volatility Opening.

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: Collared VMIM price computed on the queuing book only.

Field.Name: Buy Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Buy contracts at the Reference Price and above.

Field.Name: Sell Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Sell contracts at the Reference Price and below.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Collared VMIM price computed on the combined queuing book and the continuous book.

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Uncollared VMIM price computed on the queuing book only.

Field.Name: Opening Condition
Field.Description: Opening Condition.

Field.Name: Composite Market Bid Price
Field.Description: Bid Price of the prevailing Composite Market.

Field.Name: Composite Market Offer Price
Field.Description: Offer Price of the prevailing Composite Market.

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Auction Summary messages are used to disseminate the results of an auction, including Opening and Re-Opening on the Cboe Options Exchange.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction Type.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price or CMC match price.

Field.Name: Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative number of contracts executed during the auction or CMC matching.

Message.Name: Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: C1 and EDGX Options Only. Auction Notification messages are used to disseminate order details of an auction. Auctions will be available for a defined period of time known as the exposure period.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction Type.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: B or S.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price.

Field.Name: Contracts
Field.Description: Number of contracts available in the auction.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: Customer Indicator.

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Executing Broker (optional) of firm attributed to this quote.

Field.Name: AuctionEndOffset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last timestamp.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Optional user specified value attributed to this quote.

Message.Name: Auction Cancel Message
Message.Description: C1 and EDGX Options Only. Auction Cancel messages are used to disseminate the cancelation of an earlier Auction Notification message.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Message.Name: Auction Trade Message
Message.Description: C1 and EDGX Options Only. Auction Trade messages are used to disseminate executions resulting from an options auction.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this execution.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price.

Field.Name: Contracts
Field.Description: Number of contracts traded.

Message.Name: SOQ Strike Range Update Message
Message.Description: C1 Only. The SOQ Strike Range Update message disseminates the minimum and maximum strike prices of the strike price range used to calculate the Special Opening Quote (SOQ) on a Volatility Settlement date.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: SOQ Identifier
Field.Description: Dissemination symbol of the final SOQ right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Lower Strike Price
Field.Description: SOQ lower strike price.

Field.Name: Upper Strike Price
Field.Description: SOQ upper strike price.

Message.Name: Constituent Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: C1 Only. The Constituent Symbol Mapping message is used to communicate which options series are Constituent Series in a Volatility Settlement Special Opening Quote (SOQ).

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol.

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: N = Normal, C = Closing Only.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: SOQ Identifier
Field.Description: Dissemination symbol of the final SOQ right padded with spaces.

Bitfield.Name: Add Flags
Bitfield.Description: Add Flags bit field used in Add Order Long, Add Order Short, and Add Order Expanded messages.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Bits 0-2 Reserved (Bit 0 set to 1).

Field.Name: AON
Field.Description: Options only. 0 = Firm quote, 1 = AON (All or None).

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Bitfield.Name: Modify Flags
Bitfield.Description: Modify Flags bit field used in Modify Order Long and Modify Order Short messages.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: 0 = Order is not aggregated in the SIP quote, 1 = Order is aggregated in the SIP quote.

Field.Name: Maintain Priority
Field.Description: 0 = Reset priority, 1 = Maintain priority.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.
